description: This file defines a class for managing the start and stop operations of an Apache HTTP server used in layout tests, including configuration, process control, and server management.

classes.name: ApacheHTTP
classes.description: A class that manages starting and stopping an Apache HTTP server for layout tests, including configuration and process control.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ApacheHTTP server with configuration parameters, builds the start command.

methods.name: _spawn_process
methods.description: Starts the Apache server process and waits for the pid file to be created.

methods.name: _stop_running_server
methods.description: Handles the process of stopping the server, including killing the process or sending stop command.
